# Configuration

Zephyr reads `zephyr.toml` from its working directory.

| key | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| listener.host | 0.0.0.0 | address to bind |
| listener.port | 7443 | TCP port clients connect to |
| admin.port | 7444 | HTTP admin API |
| storage.path | ./data | queue storage |
